sentence: This project builds computer methods to find repetitive DNA sequences that cause genetic diseases in humans across the genomes of many people.
This project studies how the brain of Drosophila keeps visual perception stable during eye movements.
This project tests whether tumor cell lineage state shows how well neuroblastoma responds to immune therapy.
This project studies how proteins of the Arctic ground squirrel help brain cells survive a stroke.
This project offers microscopy and imaging instruments and image analysis to cancer researchers.
This project looks for ways to use the immune system to treat Ewing sarcoma, a bone tumor of children.
This project uses electronic health record data and machine learning to find sepsis risk and subphenotypes of sepsis.
This project studies how injury to the vocal folds helps papillomavirus infection cause disease, using mouse models.
This project builds computational methods to study how regulatory elements help a rare kidney cancer subtype overlap with other subtypes.
This project studies how cancer-associated mutations in the spliceosome change inflammatory gene expression and immune dysregulation in a mouse model of sepsis.
This project offers immune monitoring and single-cell and spatial transcriptomics services to cancer researchers.
This project builds bioinformatic methods to study what RNA editing does and how it is regulated in cancer.
This project tries to find out how histone marks shape immune and blood cell development and why stem cells become one lineage or another.
This project builds a machine learning model that uses bedside monitor data to predict which mechanically ventilated children are at risk of worsening cardiorespiratory dysfunction.
This project studies how a therapeutic DNA vaccine works against tuberculosis by shaping the immune response.
This project studies how ammonia made in the proximal tubule changes the phenotype and plasticity of intercalated cells.
This project studies the electrophysiology of biofilms across their lifecycle and uses machine learning to find drug combinations against drug-resistant pathogens.
This project studies how a single blood stem cell with a mutation expands over normal cells in clonal hematopoiesis, using mouse models.
This project builds a test based on mass spec to detect glycopeptide markers of early hepatocellular carcinoma in serum.
